scope: AU01-15 source-only candidate review; no completion, suitability, native mix or final acceptance credit

categories.title: Survivor footsteps / walk / sprint / carrying / retreat
categories.question: Footfalls rather than hooves; readable walking and sprint cadence.

categories.title: Jump takeoff / landing
categories.question: Can the short footfall trims read as human takeoff and landing without speech?

categories.title: Fist / knife / machete / club / bat swings
categories.question: Identify usable swing-only regions and any missing fist/wood/metal identity.

categories.title: Flesh / armor impacts
categories.question: Identify flesh versus armor contacts and unwanted fantasy creature identity.

categories.title: Equipment condition reaches zero
categories.question: Do the 140ms crack/clink trims read as small equipment breakage, without building collapse?

categories.title: Ordinary / tower bow release
categories.question: Does the complete short release read sharply without unrelated handling?

categories.title: Arrow terrain / wood / metal / prey / portal contact
categories.question: Classify the actual material of each first-hit contact.

categories.title: Spit windup / release / direct hit
categories.question: Is any actual wet region usable without fire/explosion identity? Name exact seconds or reject.

categories.title: Zombie movement / attack / hit / death
categories.question: Which portions fit shared undead actions; which retain an inappropriate creature identity?

categories.title: Survivor damage / death / control succession
categories.question: Can any loss-cue portion communicate restrained death/succession without music or crown loss?

categories.title: Prey flee / hit / death
categories.question: Confirm deer/rabbit identity and suitability of flee/hit/death variants.

categories.title: Paid wood / metal building and repair
categories.question: Classify wood/metal contacts; assess randomized work variants.

categories.title: Tree mark / chop / fall
categories.question: Identify mark/chop/fall candidates; exclude coin-yield or pickup implication.

categories.title: Build / upgrade begin and complete
categories.question: Confirm short noticeable start and single completion cues; identify musical content.

categories.title: Wood / metal defense hit / collapse
categories.question: Classify material impacts and collapse tails independently.

listening.blockedBy: Actual capable listener must hear exact candidate and adapted sample versions before Task1 completion

donorPolicy.selection: All forty exact relevant donor anchors exported independently before any replacement synthesis
